2.2.25 Dynamic length signals
[RS_SYST_00029] Dynamic length signals ⌈
Type:
valid
Description:
The System Template shall support a deﬁnition of dynamic length signals.
A Signal shall have either a static length or its length should vary up to some
statically deﬁned maximum. Signals with a maximum length are called dynamic
length signals.
Rationale:
Dynamic length signals can change size during run time.
Dependencies:
None identiﬁed.
Use Case:
–
Supporting
